metadata.name: Soil
metadata.role: Actual extracted RimWorld Soil supplies fine irregular packed-earth grain and scale only. Do not copy its broad solid brown fill, color, mechanics or per-cell material repetition.

donors.role: Fine earth grain only, not filled terrain

metadata.name: GrassA
metadata.role: Actual RimWorld GrassA supplies blade taper and plant/shading convention only. Its dense many-blade tuft is not the shape to copy.

donors.role: Blade taper and primary shading only, not dense tuft/species

frame: Native16x24 retained as512x768 full cell. Nominal source anchor8,16 is not a foot pivot. One fixed ground-plane camera, no extra facings.
source_facts: Dirt1 has one primary pixel at7,11; legacy grass1 has16 primary pixels in3 separated rising strokes. No source detail pixels. Dirty randomly assigns w/y + k detail for dirt, g/G grass with prior detail retained.
authored_interpretation: One small irregular earth fleck and3 sparse tapered map-plane blades preserve original occupancy/roots/tips. Fine grain, taper and center shading are authored, not a new plant species/animation.
native_behavior: Keep native options, paint distribution/tile random choice, strings, per-cell foreground/detail/background, visibility and draw order. Invisible widget itself has no drawn sprite.
selection: Direct Blender map-plane geometry preserves sparse cell layout; optional ImageGen omitted.
